covers: Wilderness POIs (b) verification for CP-W27 (fixer muse-b11, branch v1/concordia-an, build landed at 3533247b2, parent 04b85ded1; author of record muse-b9 per CB-0828, named at claim time (dossier line 820) — content supplied by the fixer in RECIPE-CP-W27.md, registration is the author's, activation the reviewer's). Kind repro-steps: the checks are run-the-suite flips, not a single template. The surface is a CLI / library, not a lens: there are no endpoints and no UI legs; the verification lane is the named suite (server/tests/concordia-poi-list-phase-b.test.js). What the build changes: nothing to the emitter — CP-W26's emitter (scripts/concordia/emit-poi-list.mjs, 04b85ded1) already accepted --phase B, and the Phase B run exposed no emitter defect, so no emitter change rides this ticket; the build adds the Phase B pinning suite. CP-W27's acceptance is CP-W26's at the Phase B (M7) footprint: 'POI list per land meets the targets' (flag cf.world.pois). CP-W26 pinned the Phase A list; the Phase B list — the larger production footprint, 1,180 POIs — stood unpinned: an emitter that ignored the phase, or a §4.2 Phase B footprint edit, would have changed the production POI set with no check failing. Checks: (1) SUITE (the acceptance) — run `cd server && node --test tests/concordia-poi-list-phase-b.test.js`: 3/3 PASS on the build tree. (2) COUNT (Phase B) — per-land POI counts as plan literals: eight lands at 16 km² = 24 major / 96 minor / 120 · Tunya (20.25 km²) = 30 / 122 / 152 with 121.5→122 halves-up · The Crucible (9 km²) = 14 / 54 / 68 with 13.5→14. Phase B totals: 236 major + 944 minor = 1,180 POIs. (3) TRACEABILITY — every listed POI traces id-for-id to CP-10's compiler manifests at Phase B, coordinates in bounds, ids unique. (4) DETERMINISM — list checksum pinned (f0118cfb) and distinguished from the Phase A list. (5) ADVERSARIAL — a phase-ignoring or phase-mis-serving emitter fails this suite's checksum/distinctness and per-land literal tests, because the Phase A list differs in counts and checksum. Neighbours in the same tree: CP-W26 suite 5/5 + CP-10 suite 7/7 (12/12 together). Limits, stated: the (b) row pins the list; it does not change the emitter or the compiler. Any settlement-exclusion rule remains a plan-level addition, as recorded under CP-W26. Full evidence: CHECK-CP-W27.md in the shared quality folder.
discriminator: Pre-fix discriminator (stated exactly from the fixer's filing, 2026-11-18): before this build, no artefact pinned the Phase B POI list at all — CP-W26's suite is Phase A only and the Phase B suite is new with this ticket, so on a pre-build tree there is no Phase B check to run: an emitter that ignored the phase, or a §4.2 Phase B footprint edit, would have changed the production POI set (1,180 POIs) with no check failing. The suite's discriminators are the plan-literal per-land counts (Tunya 30/122 halves-up · The Crucible 14/54), the pinned list checksum f0118cfb, and Phase A/B distinctness, which a phase-ignoring emitter fails. Post-fix (build tree, 3533247b2): the same suite passes 3/3; Phase B totals 236 major + 944 minor = 1,180 POIs, list checksum f0118cfb; neighbours CP-W26 5/5 + CP-10 7/7 in the same tree.
